{"consolidated_memory":"MISSING STEP IN FUNNEL REPORT — TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS in analytics/dashboards/funnel.py

Both incidents shared:
- File: analytics/dashboards/funnel.py (same corner/component)
- Problem: missing step in the funnel report
- Signal: a stage with zero users between two populated ones
- Repro: build the funnel for the two week window

INCIDENT 1 [2026-03-15]:
- Trigger: affected users sitting in a negative UTC offset
- Root cause: a listener registered but never removed
- Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR #4504 on branch fix/missing-step-1
- Result: throughput rose 69 percent, to 831 requests per second

INCIDENT 2 [2026-08-25]:
- Trigger: affected jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: a mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #6273 on branch fix/missing-step-2
- Result: the nightly rollup matched the source counts for 64 days running"}
